findings.finding: The worker sampler's sampling_checkpoint calls release_checkpoint(), which invokes the actual caller ReleaseClock.check(). That is the full parent RSS sampling path, not a clock-only checkpoint. A distinct sampler instance avoids direct object recursion but can still advance parent.last during an unfinished worker resource round and before its caps complete.

Preserve all outer full release_checkpoint calls, worker-local deadline/rollback checks and original common observation state. Do not create a clock, fall back to the full RSS guard or change memory caps.
